description: Home health agency finder + quality — Find Medicare-certified home health agencies by city+state (also zip, name or ccn) with the CMS quality-of-patient-care star rating (1-5), services offered (nursing, physical/occupational/speech therapy, medical social services, home health aide), patient outcome rates (timely start, walking, bathing, breathing, medications, falls), discharge-to-community and preventable readmission/hospitalization vs the national rate, Medicare spend per episode vs national, and flags; sorted best-rated first. Optional: zip, name, ccn, service (nursing|pt|ot|speech|social|aide), min_stars, limit (1-100). Source: CMS Provider Data Catalog (public domain). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_home_health
